content: Aaroone Attuma Nayta
GODAY Muse Siina zuma bolla haasayssiza wode Aaroone yeletaynne Muse yeletay hayssafe kaalli dizayssa;
Aaroones oyddu attuma nayti deettes; heytikka bayrazi Nadaabe gidishin hankkoyti Abihu, El7ezeerenne Itamaare.
Heyti qeeseteththan ooththana mala tiyettidanne summida.

Gido attiin istta garsafe Nadaabeynne Abihuy Siina bazzon GODAA sinththan bessontta tama ehidi eeththida gishshas GODAA hanqon boshetti hayqqida; Isttas nay baynda gishshas El7ezeereynne Itamaarey xalla istta aawa Aarooney shemppora paxa diza wode ubbaan qeeseteththan ooththida.
Leweta Ooso
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Neni Lewe zarkketa shiishshada istti qeese Aaroone ooson maaddana mala woththa.
Istti Aaroonenne kumeththa maabaraa Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza giddon ooththi maadon ba oosoza ooththi poletto.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza giddon diza ooso miishshatas istta alaafe gidetto; Dunkaaneza giddon Isra7eele asaas oosettiza ooso ooththi poletto.
Isra7eele asaa ubbaafe istti shaakettidi Aaroonenne iza nayta ooson maaddana mala Lewe zarkketa woththa.
Qeeseteththa oosoza istti polana mala Aaroonenne iza nayta ne sunththa; isttafe attiin hara asi hayssa ha oosoza ooththanaas Gaytoteththa dunkaanezakko shiiqizaa gidikko izaadey hayqon qaxxayetto.»
GODAY Muses hizgides,

«Hekko Lewe qommoti taas haggazizayta; tani Gibxe dere asaa bayra wursa wodhida wode Isra7eele asaappe issaafe issaafe yelettida bayranne istta meheta bayrata kumeth taas dummasadis; gido attiin ha7i qasse bayra gidi yelettida attuma nayta sohon Lewe zarkketa tani taas dooradis; istti taas ooththizayta gidana; tani GODAA.»
Leweta Qoodeteth
GODAY Muses Siina zumaa bolla hizgides,
«Lewe zareta istta istta zarkken zarkkeninne istta qommon qommon qooda; yelettiin izas issi agina kumidayssanne hessafe bollara diza attuma naa wursaka qooda.»
Museykka GODAY iza azazida mala qoodides.
Lewes heedzdzu attuma nayti deettes; heytikka Gershoone, Qa7aatenne Meraare geetetteettes.
Gershoone zarkketi Libinanne Shim7e geetetteettes.
Qa7aate zarkketi Amiraame Yixihaare, Kebroonenne Uzi7eele geetetteettes
Meraare zarkketi Mahilenne Mushe geetetteettes; heytantti ba sunththan sunththan ba keeththa asaas aawatizayta.
Libinanne Shim7e keeththa asay Gershoone zarkken qoodettida.
Yelettiin issi agina gidida naappe doommidi mazgabettida attumasaa qooday 7,500.
Gershoone baggati Dunkaanezappe guye baggara arshey wulliza baggara dunkaanida.
Gershoone baggata kaaleththizay La7eele naa Elyaasaafe.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaanen Gershoone zarkketa alaafeteththi, Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza kamatanne penge bolla qaaphettiza magalashata,
Gibbeza giddo magalashata, Dunkaanezanne yarsho yarshizasoza yuuyi aadhdhida gibbeza pengaa magalasha toletanne hessaththoka heytanttas gidiza miishshata ubbata naago.
Amiraame, Yixihaare, Kebroonenne Uzi7eele soo asay Qa7aate zarkken qoodettida.
Yelettiin issi aginanne hessafe bollara gidida attumasaa qooday 8,600; heytantti Gaytoteththa dunkaaneza naageettes.
Qa7aate zarkketi Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezappe guyera dugeha baggara dunkaanida.
Qa7aate qommota kaaleththiza korapinney Uzi7eele naa Elxafaane.

Istta alaafeteththi Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa bolla, maadda iza bolla woththiza xaraphpheeza bolla, xomppe iza bolla woththizayssa bolla, yarsho iza bolla yarshizayssa bolla, qeeseti dumma qol7azan go7ettiza miishshata bolla, gede Dunkaanezas ubbaafe dummatida giddo qol7a gelizaso baggara diza magalashaa gidishin kumeth hayta ha miishshata bolla isttas naagana alaafeteththi dees.
Lewe zarkke ubbaa halaqay qeese Aaroone naa El7ezeere; izi dummatida qol7an ooththizayta ubbaa bolla alaafe.
Mahile soo asaynne Mushe soo asay Meraare zarkkera issino gidida; heyti Meraare zarkken qoodettida.
Yelettiin issi agina gidida guuththa naappe doommidi qoodettida attumasaa qooday usupun xeetanne nam7u xeeta.
Meraare zarkketa kaaleththizay Xuri7eele naa Abi7eele; istti Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezappe pudeha baggara dunkaani uttida.

Istta alaafeteththi Dunkaaneza toleta, kolatata, tuussatanne tuussata isttan essiza tohota, hessaththoka hara oosos go7ettiza miishshata bollanne heytanttas bessiza oosota ooththana alaafeteththi dees.
Hessaththoka gibbeza yuushon diza tuussata, Dunkaaneza toleta, dhishketanne tole wodorota bolla alaafeteththi dees.

Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezappe arshey mokkiza baggara dunkaani uttanayti Muse, Aaroonenne iza nayta; Gaytoteththa Dunkaane giddon Isra7eele asaa gishshas oosettiza ay ooso gidikkoka he oosoza woga polisiza alaafey istta gidetto; haray oonikka gede Gaytoteththa Dunkaane keeththazakko shiiqikko hayqon qaxxayetto.
GODAY istta azazida mala Museynne Aarooney yelettiin issi agina gidida naappe doommidi asay ba keeththan keeththan mazgabida Lewe qommotappe attuma nayti kumeth 22,000 gidida.
Lewe Zarkketa Dooreteth
GODAY Muses, «Isra7eelen bayra gidi yelettida attuma naytas layththay issi aginanne hessafe bollara gididayta qoodada istta sunththaa xaafa.
Isra7eele asaa bayra nayta ubbaa saama Lewe nayta, hessaththoka Isra7eele asaa mehe bayra ubbaa saama Lewe qommota mehe ekka; Tani GODAA» gides.
Museykka bana GODAY azazida mala Isra7eele asaa garsan bayra gidi yelettidayta ubbaa qoodides.
Istti yelettiin issi aginanne hessafe bollara gidida bayra attuma nayta ubbaa istta sunththan sunththan qoodiin istta qooday 22,273 gidides.
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Hessa gishshas bayra giidi yelettida Isra7eele asaa attuma nayta sohon Leweta ne taas shaakka; hessaththoka Isra7eele asaa mehe bayra sohon Leweta mehe taas dummasa; tani GODAA.
Isra7eele asay yelida bayra nayta qooday Lewe qommotappe 273 gidi dariza gishshas heyta tirpa attuma nayta miishshan wozza.
Issaa issaa wozzanaas Gaytoteththa Dunkaane meezaaneza mala ichchashu Saqile bira ekka;
He attida wozzo miishshaa Aaroonessinne iza naytas imma.»
Museykka Lewe qommotan wozzettidaytappe bollara tirpida 273 asata gishshas shiiqida wozzo miishshaa ekkides.
Isra7eele asaa bayratappe Gaytoteththa Dunkaane meezaaneza mala miishshaa 1,365 saqile bira ekkides.
GODAY azazida mala Musey wozzo miishshaa Aaroonessinne iza naytas immides.
